newsitem.title: LEBANON: Solidere end week near unchanged in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Solidere end week near unchanged in Beirut.

text.p: Solidere shares were almost unchanged on the Beirut Stock Exchange during the week ended on Friday and dealers said blocs of demand orders maintained price stability.
A shares fell slightly to $109.75 from $110 last Friday and B shares held steady at $114 throughout the week.
Dealers said daily blocs of demand orders on the second fixing at 0900 gmt prevented price deterioration.
"There was continuous intervention during the second fixing through blocs of demand to prevent prices from falling," a dealer said.
A total of 3,723 Solidere shares were traded during the week on the 0800 gmt fixing compared to 18,688 shares traded on the second fixing.
This brought to 22,411 the number of shares traded during the week, down from last week's turnover of 31,089 shares. The value was $2,462,121 compared to $3,514,404 a week earlier.
There was no trade in the shares of the four other listed companies throughout the week: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit, and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index fell 0.02 percent on the week to 81.43 and the BLOM stock index also fell 0.09 percent to 936.94.
